title: harness: skill-guard (direct .skill.json edit blocked)
desc: Guard that blocks direct Edit/Write on .skill.json files. Fires when AI bypasses the skill catalog.
steps: SAFETY: Catches direct Edit/Write/Update on any *.skill.json path, bypassing schema validation, version bumping, and catalog registration.
SOLUTION: Use 'wkappbot skill edit <id>' or 'wkappbot skill contribute'. They validate encoding, handle the pipe separator, update catalog, and bump version.
PREVENTION: Never use Edit/Write on *.skill.json. The pipe character splits steps -- a raw edit corrupts the step list silently.
author: claude
